selection: Uniform eligible-window indices; both support contexts must end before query origin
scope: Sampled paired windows of three selected query batteries
r2: Mean window R2: compute standard 1-SSE/SST separately for each forecast window, centering on that window's actual future target mean; arithmetic mean of valid window scores within each battery/seed/phase, then equal seed and battery weights. Negative values are retained; constant windows or horizons shorter than 2 return NaN. No pooled/global or within-variance-weighted R2. R2 is a reporting metric only; checkpoint selection remains unchanged.
cross_learning: One query per call; one/two disjoint support cells; batch_size equals total variates
cutoff: Every input cycle < query forecast_start; no future covariates; no inference-time query mixing
support_time_semantics: Conservative cycle-index cutoff, not a claim of calendar-time synchronization
